description: Add the language-neutral Collective Cognition Charter 1.0.0 with mapped CCC-001 through CCC-025 rules while preserving every historical contract, schema, fixture, profile, and compatibility artifact byte-for-byte.
rationale: The Charter composes existing source-neutral contracts and adds a new immutable versioned resource without rewriting historical meanings or making TypeScript, connectors, adapters, stores, or hosts normative.

description: Add exact cognitive-object and cognition-event 0.1.0 schemas plus valid, invalid, and linked lifecycle fixtures as standalone projections of immutable Portable Cognition 0.1.0 payloads.
rationale: The resources accept exactly the corresponding Portable Cognition 0.1.0 payloads and add no parallel record version, transport, host, connector, adapter, store, or publication behavior.

description: Add seven source-neutral root exports for projection versions, depth, validation, and deserialization by delegating to the existing Portable Cognition 0.1.0 runtime.
rationale: Existing root exports, type exports, errors, subpaths, and four executable contracts remain available; the new reference wrappers preserve Portable Cognition lexical, depth, semantic, isolation, and immutability behavior.

description: Add compatibility baseline 0.11.0 and package all eight Charter and projection resource subpaths in one private unpublished package boundary.
rationale: Package 0.11.0 remains private and npm-unpublished, preserves Apache-2.0, NOTICE, CITATION, all historical resource bytes, and all four executable contracts, and makes no production, adoption, certification, endorsement, or LTS claim.
